# iosxe_voice_translation_profile (Data Source)

This data source can read the Voice Translation Profile configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxe_voice_translation_profile" "example" {
  tag = "TP_INBOUND"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (String)

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
- `translate_called` (String) Translation rule for the called-number
- `translate_calling` (String) Translation rule for the calling-number
